specs.Style Name: 60 Lakh Noiseless Button Rechargable Ring Counter

features: 1. 🔒 Lock & Unlock Feature Protect your counting with the Lock/Unlock function, which prevents accidental resets or button presses. Your Naam Japa count stays safe until you're ready to continue.
2. 🔋 Rechargeable Design Features a built-in rechargeable battery with convenient USB charging. No need to replace batteries—simply recharge and continue your daily chanting and meditation.
3. ⚡ Long Battery Life Enjoy an impressive 1–3 months of battery backup on a single full charge, making it ideal for regular Naam Japa, meditation, and spiritual practice.
4. 💡 LED Light The integrated LED light makes it easy to view and operate the counter in low-light conditions, perfect for early morning or evening prayers.
5. 🙏 Dedicated Naam Japa Button Specially designed with a large, responsive Naam Japa button for smooth, accurate, and effortless counting during mantra chanting, meditation, and prayer sessions.
6. 🕒 Date & Time Display Built-in Date and Time display allows you to conveniently keep track of time while maintaining your daily spiritual routine.
7. 📿 6 Channels – Total 60 Lakh Count Store multiple chanting records with 6 independent counting channels, each supporting up to 10 lakh counts, for a total capacity of 60 lakh Naam Japa counts.
8. 🔇 Noiseless Button The silent, noiseless button ensures distraction-free counting, making it perfect for temples, meditation halls, prayer meetings, and peaceful environments.
9. 🤲 Soft & Comfortable Finger Strap Made with a soft silicone finger strap that is lightweight, skin-friendly, and comfortable to wear for long hours without causing discomfort or fatigue.
